basic_info.description: Ideally located near Taraval shops/dining, SF Zoo, So. Sunset Playground & Ocean Beach, this home blends move-in comfort w/ rare long-term potential. Bright full-width LR w/ oversized windows, DR flows to refreshed kitchen w/ updated cabs, stone counters & contemporary vibe. Renovated BA, recessed lighting & upgraded electrical add appeal. Rear BRs enjoy west light & ocean glimpses. Lower lvl is the showpiece: soaring 10+ ft ceilings thru most of garage + extended rear sunroom with potential to infill below = blank canvas. Ripe for extra BRs or full expansion. Multiple expansion dev analysis avail for review in disclosures. Enjoy fresh upgrades now or unlock outstanding dev potential to create a larger residence w/ ocean views. A unique opp for an affordable entry into one of SF's most desirable westside neighborhoods. Construction financing available in disclosures.
